title: TI as the first tenant of the shared stack
description:
After story 7 passes and real tenant authorisation (Papyrus PPY-e0c34a) is enforced, move TI onto the shared multi-tenant stack (Papyrus PPY-fea16f) as tenant #1. TI is our own pre-production site, so it is the safe first tenant; no outside data shares the tier before isolation holds. A separate staging tenant (PPY-1192d3) remains for governance.
Scenario: TI is served from the shared stack
  Given acceptance and authorisation are done
  When TI is moved
  Then host routing serves it and the previous origin stays ready for rollback

Depends on: PPY-5e0259, PPY-fea16f, PPY-e0c34a.
